title: Returning to Dock - Docking Procedure json-json

content.content: Slow and controlled movements are key when entering a slip.
Crew should be briefed and in position before final approach.
Use visual alignment with dock features to stay centered.

sideA.content: What should the crew do before the final docking approach?

sideB.content: Be briefed, ready in position, and aware of their tasks.
